about.title: About
about.quote: They often say a good product creates a sale, but only a good leader builds a company.
paragraphs: I'm Firdaos, a user-centered digital solutions designer, and my strength is turning a complex idea into a concrete, high-performing, scalable product. For over 3 years, I've been building web architectures from Next.js to Laravel, with one obsession: technical rigor, SEO optimization and performance. I've designed and delivered more than 20 custom solutions for clients with very different needs.

I've pushed this engineering mindset all the way into the physical world. To challenge myself, I created Firdart, a fashion-accessories brand where I automated the entire digital infrastructure to sell and ship to 4 countries in its first year.

Whether it's coding a complex ticketing platform in full autonomy or optimizing the customer journey of a high-traffic site, I don't just ship code: I design business solutions that adapt to your stack and your users. If you're looking for a versatile, rigorous collaborator who can learn any technology to get your projects off the ground, we should work together.
